scope: The student, instructor, staff and partner portal, and the public website pages Seminary renders.
out_of_scope: Frappe Desk and its sign-in page; files and packages schools upload (SCORM, PDF, video) and the content instructors write; third-party pages such as payment gateways and meeting providers.
evaluation_methods: axe-core 4.13.0 in Chromium on 72 pages, signed in as a student, an instructor and a registrar, and signed out on the public pages; manual review of the criteria axe-core can't decide.

not_visited.why: Needs an internship placement of the student's own.
Same form as New Job Posting.
Needs a posting of the partner's own.
Needs an application to the partner's posting.
Same form as New Internship Posting.
Needs a posting of the partner's own.

A developer page that isn't linked from the portal.
Opens only with a recommender's emailed token.
